SSRF policy rejects an IPv4 loopback address embedded in the well-known NAT64 prefix

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
begin
  engine_config = { 'ssrf' => { 'deny_private' => true }, 'ssrf_deny_private_explicit' => true }
  engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
  url = 'http://[64:ff9b::7f00:1]/'
  result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
